Actor Takes to the English Countryside for Kith's Latest Line

Actor Kit Harington, widely recognized for his role as Jon Snow in Game of Thrones, is starring in a new winter campaign for lifestyle brand Kith. Set against the backdrop of the English countryside, the promotional material features the actor in a series of rural scenes, including posing on a horseback and smoking a cigar.

In addition to still photography, Harington stars in a promotional video where he provides a voiceover reciting Wallace Stevens' poem The Snow Man. The visual and auditory elements are designed to establish a seasonal, cold-weather atmosphere.

Collection Details and Collaborations

Created by Kith founder Ronnie Fieg, the Winter 2026 collection draws inspiration from cold weather destinations and layering. The lineup includes updated versions of staple outerwear such as the Corey, Midi, and Maverick puffers in new fabrics and details. Other featured garments include the wax cotton Darcy cropped hunting jacket, the reversible knit Jaysen bomber, a shearling patchwork Becker jacket, alongside various knitwear, flannels, hoodies, quarter-zips, denim, sweatpants, and tailored trousers.

The seasonal drop also highlights additional brand initiatives, including the latest installment from minimalist sub-brand &Kin, which offers refined silhouettes and premium fabrications. Furthermore, the release introduces a capsule collection resulting from a new partnership with Japanese menswear brand Seven by Seven, incorporating washed Japanese indigo, antique-finished suede, knitwear, trousers, and accessories. Footwear collaborations with Timberland, Adidas Originals, and Clarks Originals are also part of the release.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

The Kith Winter 2026 collection is scheduled for a global release on Friday, October 30, available online through the official Kith website, the Kith mobile app, and at physical Kith retail locations.

Readers interested in verifying specific release details, viewing the campaign imagery, or exploring the individual garment pieces can access the original report published by The Hollywood Reporter at [The Hollywood Reporter Lifestyle](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/style/kit-harington-kith-winter-2026-campaign-1236742060/).
